messages.PewterCityCooltrainerFText: It's rumored that CLEFAIRYs came from the moon!They appeared  after MOON STONE fell on MT.MOON.
messages.PewterCityCooltrainerMText: There aren't many serious POKEMON trainers here!They're all like BUG CATCHERs, but PEWTER GYM's BROCK is totally into it!
messages.PewterCitySuperNerd1DidYouCheckOutMuseum: Did you check out the MUSEUM?
messages.PewterCitySuperNerd1WerentThoseFossilsAm: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON amazing?
messages.PewterCitySuperNerd1YouHaveToGoText: Really? You absolutely have to go!
messages.PewterCitySuperNerd1ItsRightHereText: It's right here! You have to pay to get in, but it's worth it! See you around!
messages.PewterCitySuperNerd2DoYouKnowWhatImDoing: Psssst! Do you know what I'm doing?
messages.PewterCitySuperNerd2ImSprayingRepelText: I'm spraying REPEL to keep POKEMON out of my garden!
messages.PewterCityYoungsterYoureATrainerFollowMe: You're a trainer right? BROCK's looking for new challengers! Follow me!
messages.PewterCityYoungsterGoTakeOnBrockText: If you have the right stuff, go take on BROCK!
messages.PewterCityTrainerTipsText: TRAINER TIPSAny POKEMON that takes part in battle, however short, earns EXP!
messages.PewterCityPoliceNoticeSignText: NOTICE!Thieves have been stealing POKEMON fossils at MT. MOON! Please call PEWTER POLICE with any info!
messages.PewterCityGymSignText: PEWTER CITY POKEMON GYM LEADER: BROCKThe Rock Solid POKEMON Trainer!
messages.PewterCitySignText: PEWTER CITY A Stone Gray City
